interface.name: cutefish_wallpaper_tint_manager_v1
interface.description: Provides the local desktop tone for a client's own surface. This is not the composited backdrop and never includes intervening windows.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a tint object

request.name: get_tint

description.summary: listen for the tone of a surface

request.description: Only one tint object may be active per surface. After the surface is destroyed, this object is inert and the client must destroy it.

event.name: tone
event.description: The compositor sends the initial values and updates when they change. Each uint holds three sRGB channel offsets in 0xRRGGBB order, biased by 128. 0x808080 leaves the base material unchanged. Paint the offsets into semantic background materials, not into the finished window.
